clues.text: This city lies on a great river delta, ringed by rivers on all sides. One wide river, the Buriganga, runs past its edge.
clues.narrowing: Puts the player on the Ganges Delta, ringed by four named rivers.

source.quote: Lying on the Ganges Delta, it is bounded by the Buriganga, Turag, Dhaleshwari and Shitalakshya rivers.

clues.text: This city has a clear monsoon time of year. Most of its rain falls from May to the fall, in the wet months.
clues.narrowing: Keeps a tropical city where most rain falls between May and October.

source.quote: The city has a distinct monsoonal season, with an annual average temperature of 26 °C (79 °F) and monthly means varying between 19 °C (66 °F) in January and 29 °C (84 °F) in May. Approximately 87% of the average annual rainfall of 2,123 millimetres (83.6 inches) occurs between May and October.

clues.text: Long ago, this city was the chief town of Mughal Bengal. Its fine muslin cloth was traded far and wide from here.
clues.narrowing: Shrinks the list to the old Mughal capital famed for muslin cloth.

source.quote: Dhaka was the capital of a proto-industrialized Mughal Bengal for 75 years (1608–39 and 1660–1704). It was the hub of the muslin trade in Bengal and one of the most prosperous cities in the world.

clues.text: Rickshaws with bright art are a famed part of this city's ways. UNESCO counts that rickshaw art as a gem for all mankind.
clues.narrowing: Nearly decisive: one capital is famed for its painted rickshaw art, honoured by UNESCO.

source.quote: Dhaka's annual Bengali New Year parade, its Jamdani sari, and its rickshaw art have been recognized by UNESCO as the intangible cultural heritage of humanity.

clues.text: This is the biggest city in all of Bangladesh, and its seat of rule. The land's top chiefs do their work of state here.
clues.narrowing: Confirms it: the capital and largest city of Bangladesh.

source.quote: is the capital and largest city of Bangladesh

reveal.blurb: This river city was once a Mughal trading hub, famed far and wide for its fine muslin cloth. Today its bright rickshaw art is honoured by UNESCO as a treasure for all. Dhaka is the capital of Bangladesh.
